milestones.title: Shopify Product Page Optimizer
milestones.why: My first complete workflow, to stop writing SEO fields by hand.
structure: 3  write the SEO fields back to Shopify
milestones.skill: Chaining an LLM with business APIs inside an n8n workflow.

milestones.title: Automated Market Newsletter
milestones.why: To get a daily market summary without reading every channel.
milestones.skill: Scheduled data collection, filtering and LLM summarization, delivered by email.

milestones.title: Explainer PDFs on AI
milestones.why: Writing showed me whether I understood a topic or was only repeating it.
milestones.skill: Turning a technical subject into a structured document that a non-specialist can follow.

milestones.title: Shopify Store Duplicator
milestones.why: My first real coding project with an agent: a Python CLI that clones a whole store through the API.
structure: 2  the agent implements against the spec
3  review the result against the spec
so every reference is remapped in order
milestones.skill: Spec-driven development and Python tooling against a real API.

milestones.title: VS Code and Claude Code setup
milestones.why: The step where my work became professional: one workspace instead of separate chats.
structure: all my files in one place, notes too
Claude Code as the main tool
milestones.skill: Working in a versioned workspace with an agent that has explicit permissions.

milestones.title: SamourAI training
milestones.why: It gave me a method where I only had trial and error.
milestones.skill: Moving from experiments to a repeatable, professional way of working with agents.

milestones.title: Second brain
milestones.why: An agent that answers from memory gives wrong answers nobody notices. Mine has to search first.
milestones.skill: Designing a knowledge base an agent can query, with clear rules on who writes what.

milestones.title: Modular multi-agent harness
milestones.why: I was 100% on Claude Code. I restructured the harness so it can move to Kimi without breaking everything, still inside VS Code.
milestones.skill: Structuring an agent harness so the tool and the provider can be replaced.

milestones.title: Sub-agents with limited rights
milestones.why: A harness upgrade: a smaller model with fewer rights is cheaper, and a mistake costs less.
milestones.skill: Delegating to sub-agents with least privilege and a model sized for the task.

milestones.title: Skills for learning C
milestones.why: Built while learning C for a school curriculum, so the agent makes me understand instead of handing me the solution.
structure: direct walkthrough, saved as a note
quiz on the what, never the how
Every code shown is compiled first.
milestones.skill: Designing agent commands around a teaching method.

milestones.title: Model swap test bench
milestones.why: To measure instead of believing, and to question my dependence on one provider. Not yet run on a second harness.
structure: frozen by SHA-256 before a run
with an exact quote as proof
dated, per task and per check
milestones.skill: Evaluating models on my own tasks instead of relying on public benchmarks.
